mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (indicating economic strength) and the federal funds rate (indicating monetary tightening) signals an overheating economy that will lead to a market correction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and FEDFUNDS are rising (relative to their 3-month moving averages), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1.4 million units (HOUST > 1400), it signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level below 690 billion dollars (RSAFS < 690) indicates weak consumer demand, which is associated with lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 690, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 105) indicates a contraction in manufacturing, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 153.5 million) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 153.5, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A high quarterly GDP level (GDPC1 > 20000) signals robust economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 20000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.
